issues.description: The proof migration widens all three `HeapSlot` fields to `pub(super)` even though closed specification accessors can expose the required proof facts without changing executable visibility.
issues.rationale: The original executable struct fields were private, but the first review head changes `addr`, `info`, and the new tracked permission field to `pub(super)`. The same source already defines closed spec accessors for pointer, slot metadata, and memory, so widening the executable representation is unnecessary for contracts and proofs. The human reviewer requested retaining field privacy and exposing proof facts through closed spec functions; the next commit makes all fields private and keeps the accessors. This directly violates the same-head `preserve-exec-code` rule, which forbids widening visibility merely to isolate verification.
